card.name: Word after standard label instruction openers
card.fires_on: The word right after a stock label instruction opener such as "Keep", "Call", or "should be". It marks the spot where a fixed instruction phrase continues, like "Keep this product out of reach".

modes.label: The phrase about keeping this product
modes.description: "this" or "THIS" after "Keep" in the child-safety warning about iron products.
modes.example: Keep<< this>> product out of reach of children. In

modes.label: The phrase about how it should be taken or used
modes.description: A past participle after "should be" in a standard usage instruction.
modes.example: the medication should be<< taken>> exactly as directed. Skipping doses or not

modes.label: The phrase about calling a doctor
modes.description: "your" after "Call" in the side-effect reporting line.
modes.example: Call<< your>> doctor for medical advice about side effects.
